subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What aspects of the films are reviewers focusing on?

judge.implied_focus: The specific aspects of a film that reviewers concentrate on and evaluate (acting, writing, directing, plot, technical production, emotional engagement, comparisons, audience fit)

per_column.name: acting_performance_focus
per_column.rationale: A concrete film aspect reviewers can focus on, coded by evaluative stance (praised/criticized/mixed/not_present).

per_column.name: writing_script_focus
per_column.rationale: Captures whether and how the script is a focus of the review.

per_column.name: directing_craft_focus
per_column.rationale: Directing as a distinct review-focus facet with evaluative coding.

per_column.name: plot_story_focus
per_column.rationale: Plot/story is a core aspect reviewers focus on; coherent facet.

per_column.name: technical_production_focus
per_column.rationale: Technical/production craft as another distinct film aspect.

per_column.name: emotional_engagement_focus
per_column.rationale: Reviewer's emotional engagement is a valid facet of what they focus on, though its intensity coding differs slightly from the praised/criticized scheme.

per_column.name: comparative_reference_type
per_column.rationale: Type of comparison the reviewer draws is a coherent facet of review focus/framing.

per_column.name: audience_fit_focus
per_column.rationale: Whether reviewers focus on intended audience fit is a plausible aspect of review attention.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively and tightly centre on one inferable focus: which aspects of a film reviewers attend to and how they evaluate them. Nearly all columns are parallel facets of that focus, each capturing presence plus evaluative stance (praised/criticized/mixed/not_present), forming a sound, well-differentiated analytical structure at a useful granularity rather than a single restatement or generic noise. The facet set spans the natural dimensions of film criticism (performance, writing, directing, plot, technical, emotional, comparison, audience). Minor unevenness: emotional_engagement uses an intensity/valence scale and audience_fit/comparative_reference lean toward review framing rather than a strictly evaluated 'aspect,' introducing slight scheme heterogeneity, but they remain coherent with the focus. The implied focus is clearly actionable: an analyst can quantify aspect prevalence and sentiment distributions and compare against label_pos.
